about_the_game:
The legend lives… and it’s hunting you.

Step into a shadowy world inspired by classic vampire tales. As darkness spreads across the land, you must follow in the footsteps of Van Helsing to stop Count Dracula before his reign of terror consumes everything.

Your journey begins with a simple clue — a hidden passage to Dracula’s castle. From there, you’ll scour haunted forests, abandoned houses, and forgotten ruins in search of powerful relics: a candle, a lamp, a sword, and a mysterious ring. These ancient items are the only key to performing the forbidden counter-ritual.

But the closer you get to the truth, the more the darkness fights back. Van Helsing vanishes, dark magic twists reality, and Dracula’s lair lies sealed behind sinister enchantments.

FEATURES:

  • Story-Driven Adventure – Follow a narrative that unfolds through exploration, discovery, and mysterious encounters.
  • Atmospheric Exploration – Search gothic environments for clues and hidden objects that drive the story forward.
  • Quest for Relics – Gather ancient artifacts required to break Dracula’s dark magic.
  • Face the Lord of Vampires – Confront Dracula in his lair… but beware — even in defeat, he may yet escape.
  • Endless Hunt Mode – After the finale, continue your pursuit across new locations as you hunt the vampire lord once and for all.

The hunt for Dracula is not just a battle… it’s a race against time. Will you seal his fate, or will the darkness claim you?
